newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 100 METRES WORLD CHAMPION GREENE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 100 METRES WORLD CHAMPION GREENE.

text.p: Profile of Maurice Greene, who won the world men's 100 metres final on Sunday:

Made spectacular progress in 1995 with a wind-assisted time of 9.88 seconds. His best time until then was 10.20. That same year, he came second to 1992 Olympic 200 metres champion Mike Marsh in the U.S. championships.
Won the U.S. title last June in Indianapolis in 9.90, the year's second best time until the start of the championships.
Now trains with Trinidad's Ato Boldon, the Olympic bronze medallist, under John Smith in California.
